sum_adapted puts the previous centered sum at the current sigma algebra. increment/sum range bounds imply integrability of every actual exponential. Bounded predictable multiplication and total expectation iterate the conditional envelope. The proof uses no independence assumption or conditional-distribution construction.

The ordinary MGF has NNReal parameter n/4; the two signed Chernoff events combine to2 exp(-2b^2/n) for n>0. The exact baseline boundary_budget and telescoping timeWeight produce alpha/[t(t+1)]. Anytime indexing n+1 covers precisely every positive time, avoiding division by zero.

CountableConfidence works directly on arbitrary Countable J, with actual alpha_j and sum alpha_j. It does not pad a finite family or replace its budget by a multiple. Alpha_j≤1 is derived from its term bound by the total delta≤1 before applying the logarithmic boundary.

normalizedProcess explicitly uses zero if width=0. The original observation equals lower+width*normalizedProcess AE, including the degenerate case forced by its interval bounds. CE affine transport and AE congruence then prove exact centered-sum scaling on one common full-measure event. No zero denominator is cancelled.

The result is for an explicitly measurable residual/drift event of the actual probability measure. Predictions cancel pointwise by residual_sub_drift; even arbitrary real-valued predictions leave this difference measurable because it equals the actual measurable centered sum.

scope_limits: The rule family and budgets are supplied prospectively. The theorem does not license an unrestricted retrospective search over unregistered future-dependent tests.
The lower endpoint and width are fixed per rule. No statistical estimate of those ranges or budgets is inferred.
This is an accumulated conditional predictive-drift guarantee, not identification of a fixed unconditional/reset-population parameter or membership of the generating process in a fitted model class.
The selected-time corollary concerns positive finite observation times and registered rules on the same event; it is not an infinite-horizon convergence or optimal-rate assertion.
Same-team source review and author execution checks are separate evidence layers. Parent cumulative release verification remains separate.
